text:
Maya C: heads-up — Asterium QBR prep. saw an overnight embedding surge that doubled daily units. need quick triage + cost options for renewal.
Ethan B: confirmed. spike ~01:00-04:00 UTC, embed route traffic ~2.0x baseline. looks like a full reindex job.
Priya S: are they on credits or metered? that'll change ask for retainer.
Maya C: monthly credits + small overage buffer. renewal in 4 weeks 1 want to avoid sticker shock.
Jonah K: quick action list: 1) validate source 2) run a 30-day "persisting spike" projection 3) propose 2 mitigations for deck.
Ethan B: pinged their eng lead (sam@asterium.ai)  suspect the nightly reindex flag got flipped.
Priya S: fast projection pasted:
```
Baseline: 140k embed units/day
Spike factor: 2x for ~3h/night
30d baseline cost: $33,600
30d if spike persists nightly: $51,200
Suggested buffer: one-month retainer = $18k
```
Maya C: for QBR slides show: base, mitigated (batch + cache), and retainer-protected. also propose a short enablement (20m).
Jonah K: mitigation options A) temporary soft-rate-limit on embeddings route (non-critical tokens) B) sell one-month safety retainer + SE-runbook session.
Ethan B: also note feedback: onboarding guide never called out full reindex cost implications. add appendix "cost patterns for batch jobs".
Priya S: ops-bot can we set a spend alert at 75% of credits and notify CS + customer slack/email?
ops-bot: alert created: asterium-credits-75pct -> notify: customer-success@redwood + sam@asterium.ai. threshold 75%.
Maya C: assigning owners: Ethan = confirm root cause & ask them to flip to incremental; Priya = run updated numbers for QBR; Jonah = draft slide with mitigation options.
Ethan B: on it, I'll follow up with Sam and confirm whether they can switch tonight.
Priya S: i'll prepare a small waterfall chart (base / spike / mitigated) and include unit cost per 1k embeds.
Jonah K: adding enablement bullet: "20m walkthru: incremental re-index, TTL cache, backfill windows, rate limits."
Maya C: perfect. if Sam can't flip, we'll propose the retainer + SE session during renewal. anyone can chase Sam before EOD?
Ethan B: i'll chase and update here. :thumbsup:
